name: knowledge-db
description: YS-Codebase Knowledge Database & Semantic Retrieval Module

server.hint: 提供常駐背景檔案監聽熱自癒與極速預熱派發

onboarding: [Pre-flight] Configure project source directories in config/knowledge-db/contribute.json (spaces.source.include)
Optional - Download local ONNX vector model (or use lightweight BM25 via config set knowledge-db enable_vector_search false): python yscb.py knowledge-db model download
Build unified AST & BM25/vector index: python yscb.py knowledge-db index
Search symbols & code snippets: python yscb.py knowledge-db search "<query>" --json -s
